image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, white rectangular street sign mounted on a yellow cylindrical post. The sign features black text that appears garbled and nonsensical ('G:13:12:11:10:9:8' and 'US WA...'). There is a surreal, AI-generated artifact of a person in a black suit with red accents seemingly emerging from or attached to the left side of the sign. Black, ribbon-like structures float chaotically above the sign against a pale sky.
